raw_response:
This plot is only a small piece of land behind my house, and I plant cassava and a little cocoyam on it like my mother did. I cannot buy a whole bag of fertilizer for such a small piece — it would be waste of money, and the agro-dealer in town is far. I use the kitchen ash and the goat droppings I gather in the compound, and I keep the cassava cuttings from last season's harvest because they did well. The rain here is plenty, so I do not need to fetch water, and my children help me weed on Saturdays.
